title: Literature anchors for the Pass 3 growing cellular lattice and gravistimulated PIN3/PIN7 bending extensions of Slot 038 (grieneisen-root-auxin-reflux-fountain)
organism: Arabidopsis thaliana (Col-0 primary root, 4-7 days after germination)
provenance_note: Every value below is an APPROXIMATE reading of the cited figure or text by the Pass 3 remediation agent, recorded with a deliberately wide uncertainty. None of these numbers was digitised from a figure with a tool and none should be treated as a precise published statistic; they anchor the order of magnitude that the reduced growth and gravitropism models are compared against. DOIs were resolved against doi.org and Crossref on 2026-10-20.

primary_sources.citation: Friml J, Wiśniewska J, Benková E, Mendgen K, Palme K (2002) Nature 415(6873):806-809
primary_sources.role: PIN3 relocalises to the lower side of columella statocytes within minutes of gravistimulation; pin3 roots show reduced gravitropic curvature kinetics

primary_sources.citation: Band LR, Wells DM, Larrieu A, Sun J, Middleton AM, French AP, Brunoud G, Sato EM, Wilson MH, Péret B, Oliva M, Swarup R, Sairanen I, Parry G, Ljung K, Beeckman T, Garibaldi JM, Estelle M, Owen MR, Vissenberg K, Hodgman TC, Pridmore TP, King JR, Vernoux T, Bennett MJ (2012) PNAS 109(12):4668-4673
primary_sources.role: DII-VENUS shows a transient lateral auxin gradient after 90 deg gravistimulation that dissipates once the root tip has bent about 40 deg (a tipping point), roughly 2 h after reorientation, while bending continues

primary_sources.citation: Kleine-Vehn J, Ding Z, Jones AR, Tasaka M, Morita MT, Friml J (2010) PNAS 107(51):22344-22349
primary_sources.role: Gravity-induced transcytosis polarises PIN3 (and PIN7) to the new lower membrane of statocytes

primary_sources.citation: Beemster GTS, Baskin TI (1998) Plant Physiology 116(4):1515-1526
primary_sources.role: Kinematic analysis of Arabidopsis primary root growth: elongation rate, meristem size, cell production rate, cell cycle duration and mature cell length between 2 and 10 days after germination

primary_sources.citation: Dello Ioio R, Linhares FS, Scacchi E, Casamitjana-Martinez E, Heidstra R, Costantino P, Sabatini S (2007) Current Biology 17(8):678-682
primary_sources.role: Root meristem size quantified as the number of cortical cells between the QC and the first elongating cell (about 30-35 in 5-dag Col-0)

primary_sources.citation: Xu J, Hofhuis H, Heidstra R, Sauer M, Friml J, Scheres B (2006) Science 311(5759):385-388
primary_sources.role: After laser ablation of the QC/columella, auxin accumulates and PIN/PLT expression is respecified in the cells above the wound, regenerating a new stem-cell niche

meristem_cortical_cell_number.source: Dello Ioio et al. (2007) Curr Biol 17:678-682 Fig. 1 (5-dag Col-0 cortical meristem cell number ~30-35; approximate reading)

root_elongation_rate_um_per_h.source: Beemster & Baskin (1998) Plant Physiol 116:1515-1526 Fig. 1 (Columbia primary root elongation ~2-8 mm/day between 2 and 10 dag, i.e. ~100-250 um/h around 5 dag; approximate reading)

cell_production_rate_per_h_per_file.source: Beemster & Baskin (1998) Plant Physiol 116:1515-1526 (cortical cell production rate ~1-2 cells/h per file; approximate reading)

cell_cycle_duration_h.source: Beemster & Baskin (1998) Plant Physiol 116:1515-1526 (meristematic cell cycle duration of order 15-20 h; approximate reading)

mature_cortical_cell_length_um.source: Beemster & Baskin (1998) Plant Physiol 116:1515-1526 (mature cortical cell length ~150-200 um; approximate reading)

lateral_auxin_ratio_lower_upper.source: Band et al. (2012) PNAS 109:4668-4673 (DII-VENUS lower vs upper epidermal auxin asymmetry after 90 deg gravistimulation, inferred ~1.5-3-fold) and Friml et al. (2002) Nature 415:806-809 (DR5::GUS lower-side accumulation); approximate reading

time_to_tipping_point_h.source: Band et al. (2012) PNAS 109:4668-4673 Figs. 1-2 (lateral gradient dissipates when the tip has bent ~40 deg, ~2 h after a 90 deg gravistimulation; approximate reading)

tipping_point_bending_angle_deg.source: Band et al. (2012) PNAS 109:4668-4673 (tipping-point angle; used as an IMPOSED model parameter beta_tip, not as a prediction)

pin3_bending_rate_fraction.source: Friml et al. (2002) Nature 415:806-809 Fig. 4 (pin3 roots bend more slowly than WT; PIN3/PIN7 redundancy per Kleine-Vehn et al. 2010); approximate reading

literature_anchored_defaults: R_EZ_H = 0.45 (peak relative elemental growth rate of order 0.4-0.5 /h, Beemster & Baskin 1998)
calibration_choices_without_literature_v: D = 1.5 um^2/s (passive permeability ~15x below PIN permeability)
K_aux = 3.0, D_plt = 800 um^2/h, gamma_plt = 0.06 /h (calibrated to the Pass-1 table z_MZ = 255 um / z_EZ = 390 um)
model_parameter_status.pass1_synthetic_benchmarks: The six-regime QC amplification ratios (142.5, 124.8, 58.4, 11.2, 1.35, 96.2), the z_MZ / z_EZ values and the WT axial profile in root_auxin_reflux_fountain_reference.json were generated in Pass 1 as calibration targets and were NOT digitised from Grieneisen et al. (2007) or Mähönen et al. (2014).
